summary: The current ChatGPT thread contains a completed Citrus Complexity Lattice v1 Markdown contract and workbook, an incomplete Vetiver Complexity Lattice proposal, a V7 working-stock conversion, and portfolio-audit artifact pointers. Content-reference indices 12, 13, and 11 were recovered by exact Base64 transport. The returned index 10 stream was one byte short and source-rejected, but a target-hash-constrained exhaustive insertion check found one unique repair: ASCII e at zero-based byte offset 15,789. The reconstructed 18,272-byte Markdown matches the source-declared SHA-256 2c9e5e7d98f5df2b096922a994f44c2da1fa88cb84a93d32756331372d5e8b5c exactly; the failed stream remains separately quarantined as transport history. The recovered 27,095-byte workbook matches SHA-256 3810a332251949aa409b6fea9de192ca63515b74a3712339c28fb21845b028a2, passes ZIP CRC validation, and contains 10 sheets, 1,725 populated cells, and 116 formulas. All eight module arithmetic summaries and all ten application dose-preservation checks reconcile, while all seven controlled tests remain NOT RUN. Four of five citrus artifacts now match their declared identities; only the ZIP at index 9 remains missing. The candidate is not physically prepared or empirically validated, and seven of its eight modules have live-inventory blockers. No candidate is installed or admitted. The prior 11-response replacement benchmark is invalid for answer-key and role leakage; the corrected v2 blinded manifest has no submitted or scored requests.
